# apicp_tls_certificate (Resource)

Issues a Let's Encrypt TLS certificate (ACME HTTP-01) for an `apicp_web_domain` and installs it, enabling HTTPS on that vhost. Kept as a separate resource from `apicp_web_domain` so a domain can go HTTP-only -> HTTPS (or back) without recreating the vhost.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apicp_web_domain" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

resource "apicp_tls_certificate" "example" {
  vhost_id = apicp_web_domain.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vhost_id` (String) ID of the `apicp_web_domain` to issue a certificate for. Changing this replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `domain` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `issued_at` (String)
- `not_after` (String) Certificate validity end (RFC 3339) — apicp does not auto-renew yet; re-apply before this to renew.
- `not_before` (String) Certificate validity start (RFC 3339).
- `status` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apicp_tls_certificate.example vh_abc123
```
